description:
Seen 2026-10-25 on 0.18.2-dev. install-main was run under `qm run` from a Claude Code session in pane magpie (p2e8hmw6kr). Its detached swap ends with `open "$app"`, and the app it opened passed that whole environment on: every muster-bridge (e.g. pid 66521, pane p2ef615veb) carries MUSTER_PANE=p2e8hmw6kr, MUSTER_CALLSIGN=magpie, MUSTER_SOCKET=command-9311.sock (gone), CLAUDECODE=1, CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET and its token, and QM_JOB=1a17369b49f-2.

Effects seen: Quartermaster raised an orphan alert, "4 processes from job 1a17369b49f-2 are still running 2 hours 39 minutes after it ended", for the live window's bridges, and every new pane's bridge adds to it. Not seen, but likely: any code in the app or a bridge that reads MUSTER_PANE or CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET to work out who is asking gets another agent's identity.

tools/run-checkout already clears the environment to what a Dock launch gets, for this reason (its header comment). install-main should do the same for its open. Worth deciding too whether the app should drop inherited MUSTER_*, CLAUDE_* and QM_* at launch, since any `open` from a terminal does this.
title: tools/install-main opens the new Muster with the environment of whoever ran it, so the app and every bridge carry another pane's MUSTER_PANE, a Claude Code session's ids and a qm job tag
